missionStatement:
You now understand what ethical hacking is, how attackers think, what the law permits, and how a professional VAPT engagement is structured from first document to final report.

The final piece of Module 1 is the vocabulary and the toolkit. Security professionals communicate in a shared language — CVEs, CVSS scores, OWASP categories, NIST functions — and they execute their methodology with a defined set of tools. Without this vocabulary, you cannot read a professional report, discuss findings with a client, or contribute meaningfully to a team.

Your mission: learn the systems that underpin vulnerability management, understand the tools that execute each VAPT phase, and map out the certification landscape so you know where you are heading and why.
objectives: Understand the CVE, CWE, NVD, and CVSS systems and how they work together
Learn all ten OWASP Top 10 categories (2021) and what each represents
Understand the NIST Cybersecurity Framework's five core functions
Map professional security tools to the VAPT phases they serve
Plan a certification pathway based on career goals and current level
operativeNote: Tools without methodology are noise. Methodology without tools is theory. After this mission, you will have both — and you will understand why the two are not interchangeable.
